heroHeadline: Nicaragua Frees 1,500 Common Prisoners in Fifth 2026 Mass Release, Again Bypassing 46+ Political Prisoners
heroSubtitle: Co-president Rosario Murillo's September 21 'family cohabitation' benefit released inmates from eight facilities nationwide — Tipitapa, Granada, Matagalpa, Juigalpa, León, Estelí, Bluefields and Chinandega — bringing 2026's common-prisoner releases to roughly 7,900 people, per Rio Times Online. As with the four prior releases this year, the announcement made no provision for the more than 46 people still held on political grounds, whose cases the government continues to treat as ordinary crimes rather than acknowledge as political detentions.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
